# UK Health Centre

> > A comprehensive UK health information resource covering medical conditions, treatments, fertility, cosmetic procedures, and wellness topics with evidence-based guidance.

UK Health Centre provides detailed guides across major health categories including diabetes, allergies, fertility treatment, cosmetic procedures, and dentistry. The site aggregates health news and offers information on both NHS and private healthcare options, with particular focus on reproductive health, aesthetic treatments, and chronic disease management.

## Key Topics

- Diabetes (Type 1 & Type 2)
- Fertility Treatment & IVF
- Abortion Procedures
- Allergies & Hay Fever
- Cosmetic Surgery & Treatments
- Dental Treatment
- Incontinence Management
- Vaccination
- Pharmacy & Medication
- Alternative Medicine (Acupuncture, Chiropractic)
- NHS vs Private Healthcare
- Weight Loss & Nutrition
- Mental Health
- HFEA (Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority)
- Harley Street Clinics

## Major Health Conditions

- [Diabetes Guide | Causes, Symptoms, Treatment](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/diabetes): Comprehensive guide to type 1 and type 2 diabetes covering causes, symptoms, and treatment options.
- [Allergies Guide | Allergy Causes, Symptoms & Treatments](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/allergies): Comprehensive guide to allergy causes, symptoms, and treatments in the UK.
- [Incontinence Information Guide to Incontinence](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/incontinence): Comprehensive guide to incontinence covering causes, types, and treatment options.

## Reproductive Health & Fertility

- [Fertility Treatment Guide to Fertility Treatment](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/fertility-treatment): Comprehensive guide to fertility treatment, IVF, ICSI, and reproduction factors.
- [Abortion at 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 & 9 Weeks Abortion](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/abortion/abortion-stage-1.html): Comprehensive guide to early medical abortion methods including abortion pill options.
- [Abortion Cost of an Abortion Costs](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/abortion/abortion-cost.html): Guide to abortion costs in UK including NHS and private pricing information.

## Cosmetic & Aesthetic Procedures

- [Cosmetic Surgery Information Guide to Cosmetic Procedures](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/cosmetic-surgery): Comprehensive guide to cosmetic surgery procedures including liposuction and augmentation.
- [Cosmetic Treatments Information Guide to Cosmetic Treatment](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/cosmetic-treatments): Guide to non-surgical cosmetic and aesthetic treatments including Botox in London/UK.
- [Hair Transplants Guide to Hair Transplants](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/hair-transplants): Guide to hair transplant surgery procedures, options, and costs in the UK.

## Medical Services & Specialties

- [Dental Treatment Information Guide to Dental Treatments](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/dentistry): Guide to dental treatments and cosmetic dentistry services in the UK.
- [Harley Street in London Information Guide to Harley Street Clinics](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/harley-street): Guide to Harley Street private healthcare clinics and medical specialists in London.

## Pharmacy & Medications

- [Ventolin Inhaler for a Cough](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/pharmacy/ventolin-inhaler-cough.html): Comprehensive guide to Ventolin Inhaler use, dosage, and cough treatment.
- [Live Vaccinations Advantages & Disadvantages of Live Vaccinations](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/vaccine/advantages-disadvantages-live-vaccinations.html): Guide to live attenuated vaccines including MMR and polio vaccine benefits/risks.

## Alternative & Complementary Medicine

- [Acupuncture Guide to Acupuncture](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/acupuncture): Comprehensive guide to acupuncture covering traditional Chinese medicine history and theory.
- [Chiropractors Guide to Chiropractic Treatment](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/chiropractors): Guide to chiropractic treatment, spinal manipulation, and GCC registration.
- [Colonic Irrigation (Colonic Hydrotherapy) Guide to Colonic Irrigation & Hydrotherapists Guide](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/colonic-irrigation): Guide to colonic irrigation and hydrotherapy for bowel health and IBS management.

## Health News & Wellness

- [Latest Medical & Health News Stories - UK Health Centre News](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/news): Aggregated UK health news covering dentistry, fertility, allergies, diabetes, and mental health.
- [Number of women freezing eggs hits record high](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/news/freezing-eggs-record-high.html): News article on HFEA statistics showing record high egg freezing rates among women.
- [Dieting Information Guide to Diets](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/dieting): Guide to dieting, weight loss, and nutrition for obesity prevention and health.

## Optional

- [Which? survey reveals consumer confusion over serving sizes](https://www.healthcentre.org.uk/news/which-confusion-sizes.html): News article on Which? survey about consumer confusion over food serving sizes.
